text:
Maya: Quick capture from HelixCare onboarding call just now — they had 3 main asks and some pain quotes. Pulling here so PMs + eng can triage.
Maya: TL;DR — customer wants: (1) per-route usage/cost breakdown in Console exports, (2) clearer token-cost estimator per example, (3) retry/backoff visibility for failed dedicated/hosted requests.
Maya: Direct quotes: "We have no visibility into which endpoints spike cost each day," and "when a burst fails we end up blindly re-running and overspending."
Riya: thanks Maya — can you paste transcript excerpt & is this pilot or paid prod?
Maya: paste below. Pilot converting next quarter, ~30 devs and 2 prod integrations. Renewal flag: medium risk if we don't show cost clarity.
---
HelixCare notes:
- 00:12 Customer: running eval workloads across 4 routes, 2 use embeddings heavily.
- 00:18 They saw daily spend variance ~3x between dev & staging with same traffic.
- 00:45 Asked for Console CSV breaking cost down by route + model version.
- 01:20 Reported failures during nightly batch sends; want retry/backoff metrics and per-request status in UI.
- 02:05 Asked for a simple formula in Console: given tokens per example and batch size, show estimated daily cost.
---
Maya: Suggested tags: feature:console-cost-breakdown, feature:retry-visibility, ux:cost-estimator
Ethan: quick q — how many customers requested route-level cost exports recently? is this a pattern?
Riya: I logged ParkCo, NorthBay, Brightlane this quarter — overlapping asks.
Ethan: ok pattern. Maya, are they on Dedicated or Hosted? implementation differs.
Maya: hosted API for now; evaluating Dedicated later.
Sam: eng note: CSV + estimator is straightforward with per-token counters. Retry visibility needs request-level status retained ~7 days — do we have that telemetry ingested?
Sam: also need repro: are failures 5xx from runtime or client timeouts?
Maya: they saw 502s during spikes (runtime). Repro steps I used:
1) route `helixcare-ingest` model `open-ggml-13b`
2) fire 6 concurrent batch requests of 200 items
3) observe timeouts around 60s and occasional 502s in runtime logs
Maya: sample payload (internal): <https://drive.redwood/helixcare/sample-batch.json>
Ethan: proposed triage: cost-breakdown P2 (pattern but not immediate), retry-visibility P1 for HelixCare (renewal risk). objections?
Riya: agree P1 for retry-visibility; P2 for cost-breakdown but add estimator to onboarding playbook.
Sam: I can prototype CSV endpoint + Console row this sprint if PMs OK. Retry visibility needs storage + UI spike.
product-bot: New ticket RNWD-1420 "Console: per-route cost export (CSV)" assigned -> eng-triage. https://tickets.redwood/RNWD-1420
Maya: next steps: Ethan confirm prioritization & triage; Sam drop t-shirt size/spike time in ticket; Riya + I will add HelixCare quotes & renewal timeline.
Ethan: I'll move to product triage board and tag customer-impact + renewal-risk. Sync 15m tomorrow 11:15 to align?
Riya: 11:15 works.
Sam: fine. I'll post spike plan in ticket before EOD.
Maya: HelixCare prefers CSV + retry UI as a bundle if possible. :thumbsup:
Riya: capturing follow-ups in Asana: Maya (CS notes), Riya (customer follow-up), Ethan (prioritization), Sam (eng spike).
product-bot: Reminder: add acceptance criteria — export 30-day route cost CSV; Console shows per-request retry/failure status for 7 days.
Maya: noted and added ACs.
Ethan: thanks Maya, moving to triage now. :rocket:
